description: Show upcoming deadlines and interviews sorted by date, with a reminder for each one. Deadlines come from applications still in the applied stage, and interviews come from applications in the interview stage that have an interview_date. Rejected applications and offers are left out. Inputs: optional days, how far ahead to look (default 14), include_overdue (default true) to also show deadlines that already passed, and an optional today as YYYY-MM-DD to ask as if it were another day. Example prompt: "What deadlines and interviews do I have in the next two weeks?"

days.description: How many days ahead to look. Defaults to 14.

include_overdue.description: Also show deadlines and interviews that already passed. Defaults to true.

today.description: Treat this YYYY-MM-DD date as today. Defaults to today on this computer.

name: list_upcoming

days_left.description: Days from today. Negative when it is overdue.

kind.description: Whether the date is a deadline or an interview.

today.description: The date used as today, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: List upcoming
